facts.heading: Wife suggested therapy
facts.content: Tomas's wife suggested he seek therapy because the current situation cannot continue.
facts.evidence: My wife. She says it can't go on like this.

facts.heading: Compulsive checking behavior
facts.content: Tomas checks if he locked the door and turned off the stove about 30 times.
facts.evidence: I check 30 times if I locked the door and turned off the stove.

facts.heading: Time spent leaving apartment
facts.content: It takes Tomas an hour before he can leave the apartment.
facts.evidence: It takes me an hour before I leave the apartment.

facts.heading: Anxiety triggers fire image
facts.content: When Tomas checks, he gets anxious and sees an image of being in flames.
facts.evidence: I get anxious. Then an image comes to my head that I didn't do it properly and I have to burn.

facts.heading: Fire image frequency
facts.content: The image of being in flames happens to Tomas every day.
facts.evidence: Every day.

facts.heading: Fire image timing
facts.content: The fire images are worst in the evening and in the morning.
facts.evidence: It's the worst in the evening when we go out or go to sleep. And in the morning too.

facts.heading: Fire incident started anxiety
facts.content: Tomas's anxiety started two years ago after a neighbor's house caught fire.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago when the neighbor's house caught fire and we had to evacuate.

facts.heading: Fire incident details
facts.content: The fire incident happened at night, involving an alarm and smoke in the hallway.
facts.evidence: It was at night. Then there was an alarm, there was smoke in the hallway, and people were screaming.

facts.heading: Feeling of responsibility
facts.content: After the fire, Tomas felt he could cause it and would be responsible if he didn't control something.
facts.evidence: At that time, I have the feeling that I can cause it. That if I don't control something, it will happen and I will be responsible.

facts.heading: Inability to stop checking
facts.content: Tomas knows logically that his checking behavior doesn't make sense, but he cannot stop.
facts.evidence: I know it doesn't make sense. I know from logic. But I can't turn it off.

facts.heading: Anxiety escalation when resisting
facts.content: When Tomas tries to let go of the urge, his anxiety grows until he feels like he is going crazy.
facts.evidence: Then anxiety grows in me, until I feel like I'm going crazy.

facts.heading: Physical symptoms of anxiety
facts.content: Tomas experiences a pounding heart and stomach discomfort when anxious.
facts.evidence: My heart pounded in my hand and my stomach felt bad.

facts.heading: Wife is aware of behavior
facts.content: Tomas's wife, Barbara, is aware of his behavior and sees it is more than a habit.
facts.evidence: Barbara. My wife. At first she took it as a habit, now she sees that it's more.

facts.heading: Wife's exhaustion from behavior
facts.content: Tomas observes that his behavior exhausts his wife.
facts.evidence: I see that it exhausts her.

facts.heading: Incident at cinema
facts.content: Tomas arrived at the cinema 40 minutes late because his wife waited outside for him.
facts.evidence: Yesterday we arrived at the cinema 40 minutes later.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction to checking
facts.content: Tomas's wife looked at him without speaking after finding the stove was off after the third check.
facts.evidence: She didn't say anything, just looked at me.

facts.heading: Feeling unable to leave house
facts.content: Tomas felt like a child who cannot leave the house after the incident at the cinema.
facts.evidence: I felt like a child who can't leave the house.

facts.heading: Works as an electrician in Malomolec
facts.content: Tomas works as an electrician in Malomolec.
facts.evidence: I work as an electrician in Malomolec

facts.heading: Worries about making mistakes
facts.content: Tomas fears making a mistake, such as falling in a flood or damaging something.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid that because of my head, I might make a mistake, that I might fall in a flood or something get damaged.

facts.heading: Performs follow-up on jobs
facts.content: Tomas goes back to ongoing jobs on the second day to look.
facts.evidence: But I go back for follow-up on ongoing jobs. Just when I go back the second day, just to look.

facts.heading: Boss calls him careful
facts.content: Tomas's boss tells him he is the most careful in the company.
facts.evidence: The boss tells me I'm the most careful in the company

facts.heading: Work has slowed down
facts.content: In the last few months, Tomas's work has slowed down by an hour per day.
facts.evidence: In the last few months, the work has slowed down by an hour per day.

facts.heading: Fears losing job
facts.content: Tomas is afraid he will lose his job, especially now.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I'll lose my job. Especially now.

facts.heading: Partner is pregnant in fourth month
facts.content: Tomas's partner, Probora, is pregnant in the fourth month.
facts.evidence: Probora is pregnant in the fourth month.

facts.heading: Waited three years for child
facts.content: Tomas and his partner waited for the child for three years.
facts.evidence: We waited for it for three years

facts.heading: Intrusive thoughts about harm
facts.content: Tomas has thoughts that might harm his partner and the baby.
facts.evidence: That it might harm her and the baby.

facts.heading: Thoughts occur while cutting bread
facts.content: The thought about harm comes to Tomas when he is cutting bread on the landing.
facts.evidence: the thought comes when I'm cutting bread on the landing

facts.heading: Thoughts are worst when secret
facts.content: Tomas finds it worst when he hasn't told anyone about the thoughts, not even Barbora.
facts.evidence: It's the worst when I haven't told anyone. Not even Barbora.

facts.heading: Leaves room when thought appears
facts.content: When the thought appears, Tomas either leaves the room or checks something to make it stop.
facts.evidence: I leave the room. Or I come back and check something to make it stop.

facts.heading: Checking helps calm thoughts
facts.content: Tomas confirms that checking helps calm the thoughts.
facts.evidence: Actually yes. It never occurred to me that it would cause this.

facts.heading: Sleeps intermittently at night
facts.content: Tomas sleeps intermittently and gets up twice at night.
facts.evidence: I sleep intermittently. I get up twice at night

facts.heading: Walks with Barbara twice weekly
facts.content: Tomas walks with Barbara about twice a week.
facts.evidence: Walks twice. A week. Well, more or less.

facts.heading: Goal to leave woods in five minutes
facts.content: Tomas's goal is to be able to leave the woods in five minutes.
facts.evidence: To leave the woods in five minutes.

facts.heading: Goal to look forward to child
facts.content: Tomas's goal is to look forward to having a child without those thoughts.
facts.evidence: And to look forward to a child without those thoughts.

facts.heading: Fear of exposure therapy
facts.content: Tomas was afraid of therapy where a person gradually exposes themselves to what they are afraid of.
facts.evidence: I was afraid of that.

facts.heading: Fear of being forced to leave door
facts.content: Tomas feared someone would force him to leave the door open.
facts.evidence: I thought someone would force me to leave the door open.

facts.heading: Difficulty with small steps
facts.content: Tomas finds the small step of checking the door once to be big for him.
facts.evidence: It sounds small, but it is big for me.

facts.heading: Feelings for Barbora
facts.content: Tomas wants to tell Barbora that he loves her and has not lost interest in her.
facts.evidence: That I love her. And that I haven't lost my interest in her.

facts.heading: Fear of Barbora's reaction
facts.content: Tomas is afraid Barbora wouldn't want to be with him.
facts.evidence: Right now I'm afraid she wouldn't want to be with me.

facts.heading: Belief about Barbora's reaction
facts.content: Tomas believes Barbora would hug him.
facts.evidence: She would hug me. That's how she is.

facts.heading: Refusal to discuss thoughts
facts.content: Tomas stated that he does not want to discuss those thoughts yet.
facts.evidence: Not about those thoughts yet.

facts.heading: Plan to check door once
facts.content: Tomas plans to try checking the door just once when he leaves the apartment.
facts.evidence: Once. I'll try it.

facts.heading: Plan to write number 1-10
facts.content: Tomas plans to write down a number from one to ten.
facts.evidence: And I'll write down a number from one to ten.
